title: Billboard vs. TV Advertising: Cost & Effectiveness (2026)

facts.fact: Static billboard advertisements are typically contracted for a period of usually 4 weeks, with one advertiser owning the entire board for that period.
facts.quote: A single printed advertisement displayed for a contracted period (usually 4 weeks).

facts.fact: Digital billboard ads rotate with multiple advertisers, with each ad shown for 6 to 8 seconds per rotation, typically sharing the board with 6 to 8 other advertisers.
facts.quote: Your ad shows for 6 to 8 seconds per rotation, typically sharing the board with 6 to 8 other advertisers.

facts.fact: Billboard contracts most commonly require a minimum commitment of 4 to 12 weeks.
facts.quote: most require a minimum commitment of 4 to 12 weeks.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its CTV campaigns start at $30 a day (vendor's own pricing claim).
facts.quote: launch campaigns starting at $30 a day.

facts.fact: The page states that static billboards in small markets cost $750 to $2,000 per month.
facts.quote: Small market: $750 to $2,000/month

facts.fact: The page states that static billboards in medium markets cost $2,000 to $5,000 per month.
facts.quote: Medium market: $2,000 to $5,000/month

facts.fact: The page states that static billboards in large markets cost $5,000 to $15,000+ per month.
facts.quote: Large market: $5,000 to $15,000+/month

facts.fact: The page states that premium static billboard locations (highway interchanges, city centers) cost $10,000 to $30,000+ per month.
facts.quote: Premium locations (highway interchanges, city centers): $10,000 to $30,000+/month

facts.fact: The page states that digital billboards in small markets cost $500 to $1,500 per month.
facts.quote: Small market: $500 to $1,500/month

facts.fact: The page states that digital billboards in medium markets cost $1,500 to $4,000 per month.
facts.quote: Medium market: $1,500 to $4,000/month

facts.fact: The page states digital billboards typically cost 30 to 50% less than static billboards because the board is shared.
facts.quote: Typically 30 to 50% less than static because you share the board

facts.fact: The page states professional billboard creative design costs $200 to $1,000.
facts.quote: Design: $200 to $1,000 for professional billboard creative

facts.fact: The page states production and installation for static billboards costs $300 to $1,000.
facts.quote: Production and installation (static): $300 to $1,000

facts.fact: The page states CTV cost per 1,000 impressions (CPM) ranges from $15 to $35.
facts.quote: CPMs range from [$15 to $35](https://adwave.com/resources/tv-advertising-cpm-by-platform) (cost per 1,000 impressions)

facts.fact: Adwave states that most local businesses invest $500 to $2,500 per month in its CTV campaigns (vendor claim).
facts.quote: Most local businesses invest $500 to $2,500/month

facts.fact: Adwave states that ad creation is free on its platform and its AI generates a 30-second commercial in about 2 minutes (vendor claim).
facts.quote: Ad creation is free with Adwave (AI generates a 30-second commercial in about 2 minutes)

facts.fact: The Out of Home Advertising Association of America estimates a well-placed billboard in a medium market generates 30,000 to 50,000 daily impressions (third-party estimate).
facts.quote: a well-placed billboard in a medium market generates 30,000 to 50,000 daily impressions.

facts.fact: The page states billboard headlines should be limited to 5 to 7 words, since drivers have 5 to 7 seconds to read at highway speed.
facts.quote: 5 to 7 words maximum. Drivers have 5 to 7 seconds to read your billboard at highway speed.

facts.fact: Adwave states that CTV ads are non-skippable on most platforms with completion rates above 90% (vendor claim).
facts.quote: CTV ads are non-skippable on most platforms, with completion rates above 90%.

facts.fact: The page lists CTV completion rates as typically 90%+ of viewers watching the full 30-second ad.
facts.quote: What percentage of viewers watched the full 30-second ad (typically 90%+).

facts.fact: The page describes Daily Effective Circulation (DEC) as a billboard industry metric estimating daily exposure based on traffic data rather than actual viewing behavior.
facts.quote: Daily Effective Circulation estimates how many people might see your billboard each day.
